title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful. These 2 tables were very easy to put together. I did have an issue with 1 of the screws on each, but it sorted itself out. The hint I could give is to make sure you push the pc together tightly before you put the screws in Then things go easier. Beautiful dark wood on the top and middle shelf with a wonderful sturdy wire shelf on the bottom. Exactly what I was looking for.

product_metadata.title: HOOBRO Nightstands Set of 2, 3-Tier Side Table with Adjustable Shelf, Industrial End Table for Small Space in Living Room, Bedroom and Balcony, Stable Metal Frame, Greige and Black BG12BZ01
features: Side Table with Outlets and USB Ports: The charging station includes 2 3-prong AC outlets and 2 USB ports, meeting your needs to charge your phone, desk lamp and laptop freely. 150 cm power cord helps you move the tea table easily

Adjustable Shelves for Storage: This 3-tier sofa table with two open and adjustable shelves can be exchanged freely between shelf and mesh rack upon your preferences. Personalized large storage space is convenient for you to put articles, making your room far away from clutter!

Multifunctional Use:15"L x 11"W x 21.7"H in size, this bedside table features space saving and lightweight design in order to move and carry effortlessly. Greige finish and elegant style goes well with your living room, bedroom, balcony, dorm, study and other tight spaces!

Firm and Stable: The steadiness of this industrial end table comes with solid matte black metal legs and shelves. 4 adjustable feet support the balance of this side table on uneven ground and protection from scratch on the floor

Assembly is a Breeze: Thanks to the explanatory & easy-to-understand instructions and simple structure of the side table, all you need is to follow the specific steps and swing the Allen key supplied. Everything is done in minutes. So don't wait any longer and enjoy it to your home right now
